## ABOUT ME

I am an **Informatics Engineering** graduate from **Universitas Muhammadiyah Malang** with a deep interest in **Cyber Security**, **Cloud Computing**, and **Infrastructure Engineering**. I have hands-on experience across offensive and defensive cybersecurity operations and hold industry certifications including **CND** and **ECIH** from EC-Council, as well as **CCNA CyberOps** and **CCNAv7** from Cisco.

I currently serve as a **Security Engineer** at **RSUD dr. R. Soedarsono Kota Pasuruan**, where I bridge 24/7 hospital infrastructure reliability (SIMRS, physical/virtual servers, databases, network segmentation) with proactive cyber defense (penetration testing, SIEM/IDS/IPS monitoring, and incident response).

Previously, I served as **Head of Research and Development** at **LSO Kaliber** (2021–2024), developing internal web platforms, designing cybersecurity curricula, and mentoring members. I also worked for over two years as a **Penetration Tester** and **Security Analyst** at **CSIRT UMM**, focusing on web application security testing, network intrusion detection, honeypot deployment, and digital forensics.

---

## WORK EXPERIENCE

### Security Engineer (Infrastructure & Security)
**RSUD dr. R. Soedarsono Kota Pasuruan** · Feb 2025 - Present

- Managing and maintaining hospital information system (SIMRS) security, physical & virtual servers, databases, and networks to ensure 24/7 healthcare service availability.
- Implementing virtualization (VMware) and containerization (Docker) for resource optimization and high availability, alongside Grafana observability.
- Conducting penetration testing, vulnerability assessments, and real-time threat monitoring via SIEM/IDS/IPS (Wazuh, Snort, Suricata).
- Enforcing cybersecurity policies, backup/recovery strategies, and rapid incident response to safeguard electronic medical records from internal and external threats.

### Computer Security Incident Response Team - Internship
**CSIRT UMM** · Nov 2021 - Jan 2024

- Conducted comprehensive penetration testing to identify and remediate vulnerabilities in web applications, server configurations, and development frameworks.
- Implemented and maintained network security monitoring using IDS/IPS (Snort, Suricata) for proactive threat detection and mitigation.
- Designed and deployed honeypots to capture, observe, and analyze malicious attacker behavior.
- Executed digital forensic investigations on compromised systems, preserving and analyzing volatile and disk artifacts.
- Authored structured technical security advisories and remediation reports.

### Head of Research and Development
**LSO Kaliber** · 2021 - 2024

- Architected and developed the Kaliber web application as an internal organizational management platform.
- Created structured cybersecurity and software engineering educational modules for members.
- Mentored student members in penetration testing, networking, and full-stack web development.
